title: Long-haired Owl Visitor Trying to Take a Nap
fieldNotes: I was working and heard a racket out side from a lot of bluejays and when I went outside there was an long-haired howl in my tree. I shooed away the other birds and the owl seemed to let me do it without leaving. I took a few photos and videos and went inside. Came out later to another racket in the yard, different tree same owl and also shooed away those birds and now it's still out there trying to sleep.
